'''Peacebloom''' is a type of [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]]. It is used as a [[crafting reagent]] in [[alchemy]].

==Source==
*Peacebloom is commonly found and harvested by [[herbalist]]s in open fields in low-level zones.
*Peacebloom is also sold in limited supply at certain herbalism [[vendor]]s.
*Peacebloom sometimes drops from some mobs in low-level zones, especially plant mobs like the [[timberling]]s in [[Teldrassil]].
*Peacebloom can be looted from chests in low-level zones.
